# Format:
# filename|allowed_statuses|required_plates|optional_plates
# - allowed_statuses: comma-separated ACCEPTED/REVIEW/REJECTED

# - optional_plates: comma-separated normalized plate texts; misses are reported but do not fail the sample
#
# REVIEW is allowed initially because technical acceptance thresholds are calibrated separately.
# Once the real-model baseline is established, this manifest can intentionally tighten statuses.
